title: Harbor managed policy
description: Enterprise policy for the Harbor extension. Set the `policy` property to the same document an admin would ship via Firefox's policies.json "3rdparty" key. See docs/PERMISSIONS.md ("The policy file") for the full schema and examples.

policy.title: Policy document
policy.description: A Harbor policy document (extension/src/policy/store.ts PolicyDocument). Loaded at the highest precedence; cannot be overridden by the user's own policy or by per-origin grants.

version.title: Schema version
version.description: Must be 2, the only version Harbor's policy engine currently reads.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional human-readable name for this policy document.

rules.title: Typed rules
rules.description: Rules in priority order; the first match wins. Each rule is {id, effect, principal, action, resource, context} — see extension/src/policy/rules.ts.

allow.title: Allow (short form)
allow.description: Short strings (e.g. "Tool(github.*)") or typed rule objects that resolve to the allow effect. Items are left unconstrained here (no "type") because this restricted schema format can't express a string-or-object union.

ask.title: Ask (short form)
ask.description: Short strings or typed rule objects that resolve to the ask effect. Items are left unconstrained here (no "type") because this restricted schema format can't express a string-or-object union.

deny.title: Deny (short form)
deny.description: Short strings or typed rule objects that resolve to the deny effect. Items are left unconstrained here (no "type") because this restricted schema format can't express a string-or-object union.

preview.title: Preview (short form)
preview.description: Short strings or typed rule objects that resolve to the preview effect. Items are left unconstrained here (no "type") because this restricted schema format can't express a string-or-object union.

pinnedManifests.title: Pinned manifests
pinnedManifests.description: Trusted-manifest pins loaded into the Pin registry: {serverId, hash}.

trustedPublishers.title: Trusted publishers
trustedPublishers.description: Publisher keys accepted ahead of time: {name, publicKey, algorithm, allowedServerGlob}.
